# opusdns_record (Data Source)

Reads a single DNS record set (RRSet) by zone, name, and type. Returns an error if no matching RRSet exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opusdns_record" "apex" {
  zone_name = "example.com"
  name      = "@"
  type      = "A"
}

output "apex_ips" {
  value = data.opusdns_record.apex.records
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Record name relative to the zone (e.g. `www` or `@` for apex).
- `type` (String) DNS record type (e.g. `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `TXT`).
- `zone_name` (String) Name of the zone containing the record (e.g. `example.com`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format `zone_name/name/type`.
- `protected` (Boolean) Whether the RRSet is protected from modification.
- `protected_reason` (String) Reason the RRSet is protected, when applicable.
- `records` (List of String) Record data values for this RRSet (e.g. IP addresses for `A`, hostnames for `CNAME`).
- `ttl` (Number) Time-to-live in seconds.
